answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one relic weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 226 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 208 times the capital for one share. The pulse report exposes the merge explicitly at each prism. A farm of 2618 identities would post 2049 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
